subject: Request: defer demo during year-end freeze + coverage plan
messages:
From: Anna Lopez <anna@healthwave.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Quick demo request — Dec week?

Hi Olga and Marcus,

Thanks again for the intro call last week — we liked the high-level overview of Redwood’s batching/cost controls. Our team is hoping to move to a product demo next week (we have budget/planning this quarter). Are you available the week of Dec 6–10? Prefer Dec 8th in the afternoon (PST).

Attaching a short agenda and a handful of areas we want to cover (cost modeling, dedicated capacity options, private deployment questions). If that week is tight on your end because of conference travel, we can also take a shorter recorded demo or push to early January.

Thanks —
Anna Lopez
Senior Product Manager, HealthWave
anna@healthwave.com
Attachment: HealthWave-prelim-agenda.pdf
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick demo request — Dec week? 

Marcus / Priyom — forwarding Anna from HealthWave. They asked for a demo the week of Dec 6–10 (prefer Dec 8 afternoon PST). Two points: 1) Redwood has an internal operations freeze and team travel window that overlaps most of December — core engineering and infra rotations are thin the week of Dec 6 because of re:Invent travel and a planned year-end maintenance window starting Dec 18. 2) I’m partially OOO Dec 15–22 for holiday prep and won’t be on full demo duty.

Can we avoid overpromising a full deep-dive that week? Options I see:
- Offer a concise 30–40m executive demo next week focused on product fit and cost modeling (Marcus/Priyom lead), then follow with a technical deep-dive in early Jan when eng can join.
- Defer the live demo to Jan 6–12 (engineers available) and offer a recorded, shorter walkthrough this week.
- If we must run a live session in Dec, assign Priyom as primary and Laura as backup for the technical questions; Marcus can handle pricing and procurement next steps.

Priyom — can you confirm availability for a 45m slot Dec 8 afternoon PST and your comfort running the technical portion if we go live? Laura — can you be on backup for the engineering Qs Jan 6–12 cycle?

I'll draft a reply to Anna once I have your windows.

— Olga
Head, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna@healthwave.com>
Cc: olga.petrov@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — Dec week?

Hi Anna — thanks for the agenda, looks great. Quick update on our side: several of our infra and product engineers are at re:Invent and we have a limited operations freeze in the latter half of December, so we don't want to promise a full technical deep-dive during the week of Dec 6 unless you’re happy with a staged approach.

Proposal:
- Option A (preferred): Live 45m executive + product demo on Dec 8 at 2:00 PM PST. I’ll cover product fit/cost modeling and do an end-to-end walkthrough. Then we schedule a separate technical workshop (deep-dive on private deployment and quantization recommendations) the week of Jan 6–12 when engineering bandwidth is back.
- Option B: If you need fully technical coverage in Dec, we can do a live session Dec 8 but it will be lighter on dev Q&A — Priyom will lead and Laura will be on standby.
- Option C: We can defer the entire live demo to Jan 7 (10:00 AM PST) and provide a ~20m recorded walkthrough this week so you have something to present to your stakeholders before year-end planning.

Please let us know which option you prefer. If Option A or B, I’ll send a calendar invite for Dec 8 at 2:00 PM PST and share a short recording after the session for your internal review.

Also attaching a tiny note with suggested agenda timing in case we do the 45m slot.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Marcus
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
Attachment: demo-45m-outline.txt
From: Anna Lopez <anna@healthwave.com>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.com
Cc: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 17:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — Dec week?

Hi Marcus and team — thanks for the options and transparency. Given our internal calendar and the fact we need engineering sign-off, Option A + a Jan technical deep-dive sounds good. Can we lock Dec 8 at 2:00 PM PST for the 45m executive demo (Marcus leads)? Please include dial-in and a short recording link afterwards. For the technical workshop, Jan 8 or Jan 11 works for our engineers — we’ll confirm once we coordinate with infra.

Also: can you send a short capture of the dedicated capacity SLAs and data retention controls in advance for our security team (they start reviews next week).

Appreciate the flexibility — looking forward.
Anna
Senior Product Manager, HealthWave
Attachment: demo-recording-option.txt
